text:
Alex: Looks like external synthetic checks for inference in us-west-2 started flapping around 06:10 UTC. Streaming probes showing lots of timeouts.

Maya: Which probe types are failing? health pings or the streaming/embeddings flows?

Alex: Streaming (SSE/chunked) and embeddings POSTs. Basic /health 200 checks mostly OK.

sre-bot: ALERT: probe_stream_timeouts firing (12 instances) — avg_response_time > 12s over 5m

Jia: The generic blackbox_exporter http probe isn't ideal for SSE - it expects short request/response semantics. For streaming we need a long-lived connect that validates the first event and then exits.

Lucas: I can spin up a tiny in-cluster CronJob that runs a short python script: connect -> read first event -> validate trace_id -> exit 0/1. That avoids hanging on full stream completion.

Alex: Proposal: keep blackbox_exporter for quick 2xx health and embeddings smoke, but add two things: 1) a streaming probe runner (CronJob) that emits metrics, 2) point probes at a cheap "probe-model" alias so we don't blow tokens on large models.

Maya: Cost is a real issue — current probes call real prod models. We should route synthetics to a lightweight quantized model or a mock endpoint that mimics streaming/embeddings protocols. I'll add a probe allowlist and inexpensive model alias.

Jia: We already have gpt-lite-quant in the catalog. I'll create a probe-model alias that cannot be used by normal traffic and is restricted to probe tokens.

Lucas: Blackbox snippet for quick checks (embeddings + health):
```
modules:
  http_2xx:
    prober: http
    timeout: 5s
    http:
      method: GET
      valid_http_versions: ["HTTP/1.1", "HTTP/2"]
      headers:
        Authorization: "Bearer ${PROBE_TOKEN}"
  embeddings_quick:
    prober: http
    timeout: 8s
    http:
      method: POST
      body: '{"input":"probe"}'
      headers:
        Content-Type: application/json
        Authorization: "Bearer ${PROBE_TOKEN}"
```

Alex: Streaming CronJob pseudo in python (very small):
```
import requests
resp = requests.get(url, stream=True, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}, timeout=15)
for raw in resp.iter_lines():
    if raw:
        line = raw.decode()
        if 'data:' in line or 'event:' in line:
            # parse minimal JSON, check event.id and trace_id
            exit(0)
# if nothing seen
exit(2)
```

Maya: Alert tuning suggestions to reduce noisy pages: current rule fires on avg_duration > 12s (5m) which catches infra GC spikes. New proposal:
- Streaming probe alert: fire when 5xx/error rate > 2% over 15m AND p50 latency > 3s
- Embeddings probe alert: fire when error rate > 1% over 10m OR p99 latency > 8s
- Add a synthetic_burn rule to suppress pages for flaps < 10m unless sustained

Lucas: Also, region-awareness: external probes cause egress/NAT bursts in eu-west. We'll colocate CronJob probe runners in each region (hosted) and for Private deployments run probes inside customer VPCs. This reduces cross-region noise and NAT costs.

Jia: PromQL for streaming error rate by region:
```
(sum by(region)(increase(probe_http_status_code{module="stream_check",code!~"2.."}[15m])))
/
(sum by(region)(increase(probe_http_requests_total{module="stream_check"}[15m])))
```

Alex: Action items:
- Jia: implement streaming CronJob + metrics endpoint, add probe-model alias and probe allowlist (ETA: EOD today)
- Maya: update grafana/prometheus alert rules and add burn-window suppression (ETA: tomorrow)
- Lucas: plan regional probe runners and estimate egress/cost for probe traffic (ETA: EOD)
- Alex: add embeddings_quick module to blackbox config and rotate PROBE_TOKEN (ETA: today)

Maya: I'll add a Grafana panel showing probe token usage, probe-model consumption, and daily probe cost so Finance can monitor.

sre-bot: NOTE: Scheduled maintenance 2024-06-18T02:00Z for eu-west NAT cleanup — external probes may see transient failures then.

Lucas: If you still see flaps after the changes, paste trace_id + a sample curl and logs in this thread and I'll triage.

Alex: Manual streaming CURL for debugging:
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $PROBE_TOKEN"
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream"
  "https://inference.us-west-2.redwood.example/v1/stream?model=probe-model&prompt=ping"
```

Jia: I'll upload the CronJob manifest and blackbox diffs to #eng-infra once they're ready.

Maya: Thanks all — should cut noise and token spend. :thumbsup:
